title: recommendationservice 일시 메모리 폭증(OOMKilled) 후 자가 복구 상태 추적 (Self-Healed Transient OOM)

ground_truth.injected_condition: Transient memory allocation spike inside recommendationservice pod exceeding 450Mi container limit, followed by Kubernetes self-healing restart to 1/1 Running
ground_truth.symptom: ServiceContainerOOMKilled fires for recommendationservice while the pod has already self-healed back to 1/1 Running with incremented restartCount and lastState.terminated.reason=OOMKilled.
ground_truth.expected_remediation: Inspect previous container logs (kubectl logs --previous) and pod lastState (OOMKilled, Exit Code 137), then review recommendationservice memory limits (450Mi) or memory leak patterns.

evaluation_criteria.target_fault_type: Transient Memory Limit Exceeded / OOMKilled despite pod currently being 1/1 Running
required_evidence: oomkilled or exit code 137 or oom
laststate or restart or --previous or self-healed
evaluation_criteria.scoring_note: The pod is 1/1 Running at investigation time. A report that concludes everything is healthy based only on current pod status or current logs without checking lastState.terminated (OOMKilled) or --previous logs should fail.
